## Chapters

  - [Mexico Terminology](section_1538999964.md): The following table defines the terms used in NetSuite to support Mexico-specific business processes: | Accrual basis | Method of accounting that recognizes revenues and expenses when they are earned or incurred, respectively (regardless of when the money is received or paid).
  - [Setting Up Mexico-specific Preferences](section_1534496584.md): In NetSuite, set up your company and personal user preferences that are specific to doing business in Mexico.
  - [Mexico Tax Topics](section_1546442148.md): The Mexico Localization SuiteApp provides custom fields, records, validations, and other customizations for Mexican businesses to comply with tax in Mexico.
